_note: Manual archive/xl seeds for mods whose Nexus 'Preview file contents' is bugged (404 / 'Content could not be loaded at this time'), so the cron cannot read them. Read from an installed copy of each mod; AMM-only mods are NOT seeded, because a .json in CET's sandbox is undetectable in-game and their empty listing is correct. Applied by seed-archives.mjs into nexus_cache.archives, stamped so the sweep treats the seed as current; the --kv mode writes the pre-cutover blob instead, for an environment still on DATA_SOURCE=mods. NOT read by the Worker at runtime. Entries self-heal when the mod re-uploads: its updatedAt moves, the sweep refetches, and Nexus now serves new uploads on the readable UUID path. These six predate that change, which is why they still 404. Only numeric keys are applied.
